name: patrol_monk_loop
about: sp_tutorial_1's monk_upstairs_podium loops its five nodes backward and stands at the podium (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Patrol paths, walked (2026-09-12, story 10g)'). The map's logic_auto sends SetupPatrolType '999 1 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' (t0) then FollowPatrolPath 'pod_1 pod_2 pod_3 pod_4 pod_5' (t+0.1); its logic_auto fires before a map record's time zero, so the record re-sends both verbatim. The player is set down 1.6 m from the monk at 0.1 s (the Society hub is out of the start's PVS, where retail's normal think law stretches to 16 s; the teleport wakes every NPC within 2048 units, 0x1028d820). Type 1 (table 0x1049df20: first index = last, step -1, next type 1) loops backward from pod_5: pod_5, pod_4, pod_3, pod_2, pod_1, then pod_5 again. pod_1's keys carry target_name 'upstairs podium' and ip_percent 100, so the interest roll 0x1029f650 always wins there: TASK_FACE_PATROL_INTEREST 0xb3 turns to the place (match_orientation 1) and TASK_DO_PATROL_INTEREST_ACTIVITY 0xb5 claims it through 0x102a9f40 and waits RandomFloat(10, 15) (the place's min_time/max_time), then its run arm releases it (0x102da600) and fires OnInterestingPlaceLeft; the other pods carry no record and both interest tasks complete at once. Points by map Y (cm): pod_5 -9307, pod_4 -8504, pod_3 -8424, pod_2 -8966, pod_1 -9510. V4b (N13, 2026-10-04): the body is commanded retail's velocity script (0x102630b0, rebuilt every move tick by MoveGroundExecute 0x10264680) at the kernel's GetIdealSpeed 0x10091740, and stops by the script's own deceleration and the step clamp 0x10264916; the measured toggle (J9) took input_clearpatrolpath's first `arrived` from 10.428 s to 6.600 s -- the arrival creep is gone. The speed2d probe guards the cruise mid-way along a straight leg, within 10 % of this body's own walk_0: the male bank (shared/male/npc_allsequences), 136.683 cm/s -> 123.0..150.4; measured 136.683 at 6.5 s.
known_red: nav bake / navigator arrival at pod_1 (game red, not N13; no V4 lane owns it -- for the judge, the V13 family): the four legs pod_5..pod_2 now arrive without the creep (V4b: 2.6 / 6.5 / 3.9 / 4.6 s at 136.683 cm/s), but on the fifth, to pod_1 (-18821 -9509, the podium), the body slows and stops 87 cm (2-D + floor offset, measured at +5.5 s; 105 cm and 34 cm/s at +4.3 s) from the goal -- outside the program's 20-unit (51 cm) tolerance -- and the navigator fails `Don't have a route (0xc)` 5.6 s into the leg, then every 1.2 s. Present before V4b in the same place (move fail 12 at 32.933 at c7a2645c, hidden behind the creep's time) and independent of the player's seat (moved 5.5 m away: identical). Read as the follower's path ending short of the node (the baked navmesh does not reach pod_1's point); not confirmed against the bake
notes: taskdone of the podium activity cannot come before 10 s after it starts (min_time 10); the window is not pinned with a never because the trace's never takes no relative window (harness gap).
